tellMe: Tell me what you want to build, and I’ll set up Kobble with you.
read: I read your project, so you only have to confirm what I found. Let’s go through it.

leads.hello: I read your project so you only have to confirm what I found. Go through the steps; you can always come back.
leads.product: What your product is, its parts, and how far it has come.
leads.people: The people you build for. Kobble tests ideas against them, so they should be real. Add your own.
leads.team: Who works on it, and where the work is tracked. Everyone can do everything.
leads.how: The parts of Kobble that fit how you work. You can change them later in Settings.
leads.bring: What you have already, and what happens to it.
leads.start: Pick one and Kobble opens it with the canvas already started. Or look around first.

says.product: Here is your product as I read it. Click a card to correct it, or take it off.
says.people: These are the people I think you build for. Add the real ones you know.
says.team: I found who works on it in the history, and where the work is tracked.
says.how: These fit how you’ve worked so far. Change anything you like.
says.bring: This is what you have already, and what happens to it.
says.setup: When you press Set up Kobble, I write it all into your repository.
says.start: From what I read, these are worth starting with.
says.changing: One moment, I’m changing the cards…

rail.label: Setup steps
rail.minutes: About 7 minutes. You can change all of it later in Settings and Personas.
rail.nextWrites: Next, Kobble writes all of this into your repository.

cards.everyone: Everyone can do everything. Kobble only uses this list to recognise who is at a computer.
cards.building: Every computer with Kobble can build. A card is built by one at a time: the one that starts it says so on the card, and the others leave it.
cards.title: Title

look.yoursText: Your app’s colours, fonts and corners, taken from its code when Kobble is set up, and your logo.
look.ownText: The kobold logo, calm grey and blue.

team.cardsText: How many cards each computer builds at the same time.
team.usageText: Writes down how Kobble is used, for a study. Kept on each person’s computer.

done.title: Kobble is set up
done.lead: Everything is in place. One last step: pick where to start.

building.title: Setting up Kobble
building.lead: The kobold writes everything we went through into your repository. This takes a few minutes.

before.title: Set up
before.lead: Kobble writes all of this into your repository, in a branch you can look at before you share it.

plan.folder: Writing the factory folder, its settings and the rules each app keeps
plan.bring: Bringing over what you have: the knowledge base into docs/, Kobble’s skills

coach.label: The coach
coach.build: What do you want to build?
